ESL broadcasts are about to show up in your Facebook feed

Facebook has inked a deal with esports tournament organizer ESL, the Wall Street Journal reports. The social media giant will broadcast ESL events, player interviews, and more. The deal is non-exclusive, so the events will continue to be broadcast on Twitch as well.Financial terms weren't disclosed. It's not Facebook's first foray into esports. Earlier this year, Facebook partnered with G2 Esports
Virtus Pro Relegated From ESL Pro League
Virtus Pro are out of next season's ESL Pro League thanks to PENTA. Hellraisers maintained their own spot after taking down BIG.
